verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The compiled materializers preserve the previously reviewed fail-before-mutation ordering: cached rule compilation and complete fact assembly/validation precede stripping reserved graphs or replacing the authorization view. Reserved-space graphs are excluded in both control/resource and WAC group-document assembly. The WAC, ACP, and ACP-provenance differential tests compare non-empty installed authorization views against the text evaluator; the fact-adapter test checks direct IDs against a text round trip; and the failed-rematerialization test exercises both real materializer paths while proving the previous non-empty view survives validation errors. No instruction-like content or prompt injection appears in the diff. Because the prior round also had no findings and approved the same material change, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
